hakkinda.aciklama: What Klip Dergi is, our principles, masthead and takedown policy.
hakkinda.giris: An online magazine that brings together entrepreneur clips that went viral on podcasts. For each person: a short biography, social media accounts and the clips they speak in, on a single page.

ilkeler.metin: No video files are stored on our site. Clips are shown only through links and the platforms' official embed tools.
Every biography is written by our team in our own words, based on verified sources.
The photos we use are openly licensed; the photographer, license and source are credited under each photo.

hakkinda.kaldirmaMetin: If you object to a clip, biography or photo on our site, write to us at our contact address. Content that is objected to
